name: Sukri
desc: Sukri in thick rigid wraps and a wide round hood, a glass cup of noon light swinging from the crook of his walking staff.

name: Stillwater Wanderer
desc: Wet-stone wraps and a river-glass cup, with rigid reed plates on the hood, the colours of the Fallen Shaft shallows.

name: Shadeprint Wanderer
desc: Ink wraps with light rims and a pale hood, printed in ink and light. The cup holds violet light.
